SCGIS Vancouver will be attending GIS Day 2026, where we will announce the winners of our [Maps for Conservation](2026-11-maps-for-conservation.qmd) competition.

GIS Day is an annual worldwide celebration of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) technology and community, dedicated to promoting geospatial literacy, education, and awareness.
